method: Six fresh inputs committed before generation. One first-reveal HTTP request per model per input using the same frozen short-roast-v13 code, initial prompt messages, lane mix, examples, judges, temperature, token cap and runtime deadlines. Normal app retries and rescue remain enabled. No manual rerolls or substitutions. Model-compatible routing/reasoning settings vary as recorded. Separate preview deployments have no production database credentials. Model identity was checked for every response. Only actual requested-model first reveals enter the rating files; all failed or fallback attempts remain documented with empty top3. This is one unreplicated exploratory sample, not a population estimate.

promptVerification.method: Reconstructed both initial request messages from the frozen commit with preview-equivalent absence of database credentials; hashes match across the three model IDs.
